summary: Iteration 3 retest of the 4 fixes plus a regression pass. All passed. Backend: new pytest file with 10 tests, 10 passed. Frontend: checked with Playwright. (1) The workbench menu for 'production' on the Trial page shows उत्पादन (APPROVED), निर्माण and प्रोडक्शन (ALSO ACCEPTED), with no Avoid section. Admin page payloads for r38-primary-bundle and seed-trial-r38-2025-conclusion show production and audit taken from the CSV (audit: लेखापरीक्षा + संपरीक्षा, लेखापरीक्षा करना, ऑडिट; avoid empty), and the watch words contain neither प्रोडक्शन nor ऑडिट. (2) The menu has no 'Transliteration' option while the key is invalid (/api/xlit was called and returned no suggestions). (3) The test buttons for translation, transliteration, TTS and LLM all show 'BHASHINI rejected the key (not authenticated). Re-enter the Dhruva key…'. Status pills read 'key set · use Test' before testing and 'N recent failures' after; no 'ready' pill. A bad service ID shows an error banner; Discard clears it and restores the value. (4) The Replace checkbox is unticked by default. With it ticked, a 1-row CSV opens a 'Type REPLACE' prompt; I dismissed it and nothing changed. A merge of 1 row shows 'Imported 1 term'. A merge keeps a manual avoid form and drops one that the CSV now accepts. Regression: Trial submit works through the API (score 20) and the UI (two-step submit → /report scoring screen). Manager Overview and Settings load. /api/health returns 200.
